77601.commentary: (THIa) khandhadhātuāyatanan'ti rūpakkhandh'ādayo ime pañcakkhandhā, cakkhudhātuādayo imā aṭṭhārasadhātuyo, cakkh'āyatan'ādīni imāni dvādas'āyatanānī'ti evaṃ khandhā dhātuyo āyatanāni cā'ti sabbaṃ idaṃ rūp'ārūpadhammajātaṃ samecca sambhuyya paccayehi katattā saṅkhataṃ

examples.text: khandhadhātuāyatanaṃ, saṅkhataṃ jātimūlakaṃ dukkhaṃ, yoniso anuvicinantī, vāreyyaṃ kissa iccheyyaṃ.

77611.commentary: (THIa) aniccasaññaṃ subhāvetī'ti jhānato vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ pādakaṃ katvā vipassanaṃ paṭṭhapetvā yaṃkiñci rūpan'ti-ādinā (a. ni. 4.181, ma. ni. 1.244, paṭi. ma. 1.48) anicc'ānupassanaṃ suṭṭhu bhāveti, aniccasaññāgahaṇen'eva c'ettha dukkhasaññ'ādīnam'pi gahaṇaṃ katan'ti veditabbaṃ.

77619.commentary: (THa) evaṃ viharamānassā'ti, evaṃ vivittasen'āsanasevan'ādinā vipassanāvasena yuttayogatāpariyosānena vidhinā viharantassa. (THIa) evaṃ viharamānāyā'ti evaṃ mama puttena abhayattherena uddhaṃ pādatalā'ti-ādinā dinne ovāde ṭhatvā sabbakāyaṃ asubhato disvā ek'aggacittā tattha bhūt'upādāyabhede rūpadhamme tappaṭibaddhe vedan'ādike arūpadhamme pariggahetvā tattha tilakkhaṇaṃ āropetvā anicc'ānupassan'ādi-vasena viharamānāya.

examples.text: evaṃ viharamānāya, sabbo rāgo samūhato, pariḷāho samucchinno, sītibhūt'āmhi nibbutā'ti.
evaṃ viharamānassa, suddhikāmassa bhikkhuno, khīyanti āsavā sabbe, nibbutiñ'c'ādhigacchatī'ti.

77620.commentary: (THIa) amma, jīvā'ti māt'upacāranāmena dhītuyā ālapanaṃ, idañ'c'assā vippalapan'ākāradassanaṃ.

examples.text: amma jīvā'ti vanamhi kandasi, attānaṃ adhigaccha ubbiri, cull'āsītisahassāni, sabbā jīvasanāmikā, etamh'āḷāhane daḍḍhā, tāsaṃ kam'anusocasi.

examples.text: sattisūl'ūpamā kāmā, khandh'āsaṃ adhikuṭṭanā, yaṃ tvaṃ kāmaratiṃ brūsi, aratī dāni sā mama.

77622.meaning1: name of an arahant nun; great disciple of the Buddha; foremost nun in remembering previous lives; Bhaddā Kāpilānī
77622.commentary: (ANa) pubbenivāsan'ti pubbe nivutthakkhandhasantānaṃ anussarantīnaṃ bhaddā kāpilānī aggā'ti dasseti. sā kira padum'uttarabuddhakāle haṃsavatiyaṃ kulagehe nibbattitvā satthu dhammadesanaṃ suṇantī satthāraṃ ekaṃ bhikkhuniṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarantīnaṃ aggaṭṭhāne ṭhapentaṃ disvā adhikārakammaṃ katvā taṃ ṭhān'antaraṃ patthesi. sā kappasatasahassaṃ devamanussesu saṃsaritvā anuppanne buddhe bārāṇasiyaṃ kulagehe paṭisandhiṃ gaṇhitvā attano sāmibhaginiyā saddhiṃ kalahaṃ karontī tāya paccekabuddhassa piṇḍapāte dinne, ayaṃ imassa piṇḍapātaṃ datvā attano vasaṃ vattetī'ti paccekabuddhassa hatthato pattaṃ gaṇhitvā bhattaṃ chaḍḍetvā kalalassa pūretvā adāsi. mahājano bālā ayan'ti garahitvā, yāya te saddhiṃ kalaho kato, tassā kiñci na karosi, paccekabuddho te kiṃ aparajjhatī'ti āha. sā tesaṃ vacanena lajjāyamānā puna pattaṃ gahetvā kalalaṃ hāretvā dhovitvā gandhacuṇṇena ubbaṭṭetvā catumadhurassa pūretvā upari āsittena padumagabbhavaṇṇena sappinā vijjotamānaṃ paccekabuddhassa hatthe ṭhapetvā yathā ayaṃ piṇḍapāto obhāsajāto, evaṃ obhāsajātaṃ me sarīraṃ hotū'ti patthanaṃ paṭṭhapesī'ti sabbaṃ mahākassapattherassa vatthumhi vuttanayen'eva veditabbaṃ. (THIa) tath'eva bhaddākāpilānī'ti yathā mahākassapo etāhi yathāvuttāhi tīhi vijjāhi tevijjo maccuhāyī ca, tath'eva bhaddākāpilānī tevijjā maccuhāyinī'ti.
77622.notes: Therīgāthā verses 63-66 (TH4.1, TH37) are attributed to her.

examples.text: tath'eva bhaddā kāpilānī, tevijjā maccuhāyinī, dhāreti antimaṃ dehaṃ, jetvā māraṃ savāhanaṃ.
etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvikānaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarantīnaṃ yadidaṃ bhaddā kāpilānī.
cātuddasiṃ pañcadasiṃ, yā ca pakkhassa aṭṭhamī, pāṭihāriyapakkhañ'ca, aṭṭh'aṅgasusamāgataṃ.

77636.meaning1: ball the size of a jujube pip
77636.commentary: (THIa) mahiṃ jambudīpam'upanītaṃ. kol'aṭṭhimattaguḷikā, mātā mātusv'eva nappahontī'ti jambudīpo'tisaṅkhātaṃ mahāpathaviṃ kol'aṭṭhimattā badar'aṭṭhimattā guḷikā katvā tatth'ek'ekā ayaṃ me mātu, ayaṃ me mātumātū'ti evaṃ vibhājiyamāne tā guḷikā mātā mātūsv'eva nappahonti, mātā mātūsu akhīṇāsv'eva pariyantikā tā guḷikā parikkhayaṃ pariyādānaṃ gaccheyyuṃ, na tv'eva anamatagge saṃsāre saṃsarato sattassa mātumātaro'ti. evaṃ jambudīpamahiṃ saṃsārassa dīghabhāvena upamābhāvena upanītaṃ manasi karohī'ti.

aparimitañ'ca dukkhaṃ, bahūni ca cittadomanassāni, anubhohisi kāmayutto, paṭinissaja addhuve kāme.

examples.text: aparimitañ'ca dukkhaṃ, bahūni ca cittadomanassāni, anubhohisi kāmayutto, paṭinissaja addhuve kāme.
aparimitañ'ca dukkhaṃ, bahūni ca cittadomanassāni, anubhohisi kāmayutto, paṭinissara addhuve kāme.

77652.meaning1: seized by death and illness; taken by dying and disease
77652.commentary: (THIa) jarāmaraṇabyādhigahitā, sabbā sabbattha jātiyo'ti yasmā hīn'ādi-bhedabhinnā sabbattha bhav'ādīsu jātiyo jarāmaraṇabyādhinā ca gahitā, tehi aparimuttā

examples.text: ajaramhi vijjamāne, kiṃ tava kāmehi yesu jarā, maraṇabyādhigahitā, sabbā sabbattha jātiyo.

77653.commentary: (THIa) ajjā'pi ca labhanīyaṃ idāni'pi adhigamanīyaṃ adhigantuṃ sakkā.

examples.text: adhigatam'idaṃ bahūhi, amataṃ ajjā'pi ca labhanīyam'idaṃ, yo yoniso payuñjati, na ca sakkā aghaṭamānena.

77654.grammar: prp of na ghaṭati, neg, intrans
77654.meaning1: not trying; not striving; not making an effort
77654.commentary: (THIa) na ca sakkā aghaṭamānenā'ti yo pana yoniso na payuñjati, tena aghaṭamānena na ca sakkā, kadāci'pi laddhuṃ na sakkā'y'evā'ti attho.

examples.text: adhigatam'idaṃ bahūhi, amataṃ ajjā'pi ca labhanīyam'idaṃ, yo yoniso payuñjati, na ca sakkā aghaṭamānena.

77655.meaning1: who sees the truth of liberation; witnessing the reality of release
77655.commentary: (THIa) kin'ti yācatī'ti āha vissajjetha sumedhaṃ, pabbajituṃ vimokkhasaccadassā'ti, sumedhaṃ rājaputtiṃ pabbajituṃ vissajjetha, sā ca pabbajitvā vimokkhasaccadassā aviparītanibbānadassāvinī hotū'ti attho.

examples.text: vissajjetha sumedhaṃ, pabbajituṃ vimokkhasaccadassā, cha abhiññā sacchikatā, aggaphalaṃ sikkhamānāya.

77657.commentary: (THIa) sokabhayabhītā'ti ñātiviyog'ādihetuto sabbasmā'pi saṃsārabhayato bhītā ñāṇ'uttaravasena utrāsitā.

examples.text: vissajjitā mātāpitūhi, pabbaji sokabhayabhītā, cha abhiññā sacchikatā, aggaphalaṃ sikkhamānāya.

77658.meaning1: course of previous lives; details of former existences
77658.commentary: (THIa) chaḷabhiññāva siddhiyā kathan'ti ce pubbenivāsacaritaṃ, yathā byākari pacchime kāle'ti, pacchime khandhaparinibbānakāle attano pubbenivāsapariyāpannacaritaṃ yathā byākāsi, tathā taṃ jānitabban'ti.

examples.text: acchariyam'abbhutaṃ taṃ, nibbānaṃ āsi rājakaññāya, pubbenivāsacaritaṃ, yathā byākari pacchime kāle.
dasakkhattuṃ satakkhattuṃ, dasasatakkhattuṃ satāni ca satakkhattuṃ, devesu uppajjimha, ko pana vādo manussesu.

77660.commentary: (THIa) taṃ paṭhamasamodhānan'ti tadeva satthusāsanadhammena paṭhamaṃ samodhānaṃ paṭhamo samāgamo, tadeva satthusāsanadhamme abhiratāya pariyosāne nibbānan'ti phal'ūpacārena kāraṇaṃ vadati.

examples.text: so hetu so pabhavo, taṃ mūlaṃ sā'va sāsane khantī, taṃ paṭhamasamodhānaṃ, taṃ dhammaratāya nibbānaṃ.

77664.synonym: abbajati, āgacchati, upanivattati, paccāgacchati, pacceti, paṭikkamati, punupeti

examples.text: n'etaṃ assa patirūpaṃ, ākiñcaññañ'hi patthaye, yo jātarūpaṃ rajataṃ, chaḍḍetvā punarāgame.

77665.synonym: anupāpuṇāti, āgacchati, upanivattati, pacceti, paṭikkamati, pāpuṇāti, punarāgamati, punupeti
77665.commentary: (THIa) yo jātarūparajataṃ, chaḍḍetvā punarāgame'ti yo puggalo suvaṇṇaṃ rajataṃ aññam'pi vā kiñci dhanajātaṃ chaḍḍetvā puna taṃ gaṇheyya, so paṇḍitānaṃ antare kathaṃ sīsaṃ ukkhipeyya?

examples.text: n'etaṃ assa patirūpaṃ, ākiñcaññañ'hi patthaye, yo jātarūpaṃ rajataṃ, chaḍḍetvā punarāgame.

77666.meaning1: like poison; similar to a toxin

77670.meaning1: pale; wan; off colour; of sickly appearance
77670.commentary: (THIa) kisā paṇḍu vivaṇṇā cā'ti evaṃ ukkaṇṭhitabhāvena kisā dhamanisanthatagattā uppaṇḍ'uppaṇḍukajātā tato eva vivaṇṇā vigatachavivaṇṇā ca hutvā.

77671.meaning1: soma plant; soma extract; soma sacrifice

77673.commentary: (THIa) varaṃ me idha ubbandhaṃ… ubbandhaṃ bandhitvā maraṇaṃ me varaṃ seṭṭhan'ti attho.

examples.text: tato rajjuṃ gahetvāna, pāvisiṃ vanam'antaraṃ, varaṃ me idha ubbandhaṃ, yañ'ca hīnaṃ pun'ācare.

77678.grammar: prp of pass of pa √kuth, pass, intrans

77682.meaning1: (expressing dismay) oh dear!; oh no!; woe!
77682.commentary: (THa) aho vatā no amarā'ti c'āhū'ti aho vata amhākaṃ ñātī amarā siyun'ti ca kathenti, gāthāsukh'atthañ'h'ettha vatā-iti dīghaṃ katvā vuttaṃ.

examples.text: kandanti naṃ ñātī pakiriya kese, ahovatā no amarā'ti c'āhu, vatthena naṃ pārutaṃ nīharitvā, citaṃ samādhāya tatoḍahanti.
rājā satthu vacanaṃ sutvā, aho, bhante, bhāriyaṃ kammaṃ, ettake nāma bhoge vijjamāne n'eva attanā paribhuñji, na tumhādise buddhe dhuravihāre viharante puññakammaṃ akāsī'ti āha.

77683.meaning1: expression of affection; dear; girl; my love
77683.meaning2: often used to address a girl or a daughter
77683.commentary: (THIa) amma, jīvā'ti māt'upacāranāmena dhītuyā ālapanaṃ, idañ'c'assā vippalapan'ākāradassanaṃ.

examples.text: amma jīvā'ti vanamhi kandasi, attānaṃ adhigaccha ubbiri, cull'āsītisahassāni, sabbā jīvasanāmikā, etamh'āḷāhane daḍḍhā, tāsaṃ kam'anusocasi.

77684.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of sama (+instr)
77684.commentary: (THIa) ekakappam'aṭṭhīnaṃ, sañcayaṃ vipulena saman'ti ekassa puggalassa ekasmiṃ kappe aṭṭhīnaṃ sañcayaṃ vepullapabbatena samaṃ upanītaṃ sara.

examples.text: sara catur'odadhī, upanīte assuthaññarudhiramhi, sara ekakappam'aṭṭhīnaṃ, sañcayaṃ vipulena samaṃ.

77685.meaning1: lived in such a way; had a certain lifestyle

77689.commentary: (VINa) aññaṃ byākariṃsū'ti arahattaṃ byākariṃsu, pattaṃ āvuso amhehi arahattaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyan'ti bhikkhūnaṃ ārocesuṃ.

examples.text: itthaṃ sudaṃ tiṃsamattā therī bhikkhuniyo paṭācārāya santike aññaṃ byākariṃsū'ti.

77690.meaning1: from house to house; from door to door
77690.commentary: (THa) kulā kulan'ti kulato kulaṃ, kul'ānupubbiyā gharapaṭipāṭiyā'ti attho.

examples.text: pattaṃ daṇḍañ'ca gaṇhitvā, bhikkhamānā kulā kulaṃ, sīt'uṇhena ca ḍayhantī, satta vassāni cāri'haṃ.

77692.meaning1: having waged war (against); having engaged in battle (with); having fought

examples.text: raṇaṃ karitvā kāmānaṃ, sītibhāv'ābhikaṅkhinī, appamattā vihassāmi, sabbasaṃyojanakkhaye.

77696.commentary: (THa) bālā'ti bālyena samannāgatā idhalokaparalok'atthaṃ ajānantā. (THa) bālā'ti duccintitacintan'ādinā bālalakkhaṇena samannāgatā

examples.text: nakkhattāni namassantā, aggiṃ paricaraṃ vane, yathābhuccam'ajānantā, bālā suddhim'amaññatha.

77697.grammar: masc, in comps, irreg form of atta
77697.commentary: (THIa) dhītā majjhassa atrajā'ti majjhanāmassa seṭṭhino orasā dhītā.

examples.text: ucce kule ahaṃ jātā, bahuvitte mahaddhane, vaṇṇarūpena sampannā, dhītā majjhassa atrajā.
